title: H3 Image to Video
description: Animate an image: the video starts on it. Add a last frame to end on a second image, or leave both empty for text to video.

labels.114:image: First frame (the video starts on this image)
labels.105:104:prompt: Describe the motion, the camera and the sound.

extra_refs.label: Last frame (the video ends on this image)

controls.label: Size in megapixels (0.4 is about 848 x 480, 0.9 about 1280 x 720)

hints: Pick the aspect ratio that matches your image, or it will be cropped.
Describe the motion, the camera and the sound. The image already shows what things look like.
5-6 s clips give the best results. For longer videos use Long video, which chains clips.
Larger sizes take much longer. Start at 0.4 megapixels and go up once the motion is right.
